newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys two jet fuel cargoes for December.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys two jet fuel cargoes for December.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender two 32,000-tonne jet fuel cargoes for arrival in the second half of December, a company official said on Thursday.
The cargoes were awarded at around $241-242 per tonne for delivery to Keelung or Shen Ao on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis. The tender closed on November 6 and offers are valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought two 32,000-tonne cargoes of jet fuel at around $247 a tonne, for end October and early November arrival, c-and-f basis.
